title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.11312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages.

translated_title: MedBenchAgent：迈向医学视觉语言模型基准构建的系统性自动化
translated_abstract: 随着标注丰富的医学影像数据集和大语言模型（LLM）的发展，大规模构建医学视觉语言模型（VLM）基准变得越来越可行，然而现有的自动化方法主要局限于在预定义的基准规范内生成评测条目。我们研究了更广泛的问题，即自动推导基准规范本身：评测什么内容、哪些标注支持每个任务，以及如何将这些证据转化为可靠的评测条目。我们将基准构建形式化为约束编译问题，其中基准规范从评测需求、异构标注和医学知识中逐步推导得出。基于这一形式化，我们提出了MedBenchAgent，一个多智能体框架，其配备的基准中间表示（BIR）可在整个构建流程的各阶段编码任务定义、证据映射、评测协议和条目规范。
tldr: 该论文提出MedBenchAgent多智能体框架，将医学VLM基准构建形式化为约束编译问题，并通过基准中间表示（BIR）实现从评测需求、异构标注到可靠评测条目的全流程自动化规范推导。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework that formulates medical VLM benchmark construction as constrained compilation and leverages a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) to automatically derive benchmark specifications and reliable evaluation items from evaluation requirements and heterogeneous annotations.
